profile.name: Reza Nazariye
profile.intro: M.Sc. student in Electrical Engineering (Digital Electronics) at Sharif University of Technology.

about.body:
I'm an electrical engineer focused on digital design, FPGA systems, and embedded hardware. I'm most interested in the point where hardware and software meet: writing Verilog for an FPGA, then driving it from bare-metal C on an ARM processor, or building a Linux service around a camera.

My research in the Power Electronics Laboratory showed me what it takes to build systems that work in the real world, where a monitoring design has to hold up under noise and component failure. Teaching has been just as important: over several semesters I have helped students through problem sets and full implementation projects, and explaining a topic has taught me as much as learning it.

I'm really into Persian poetry. 
I also have a 3D printer, my dear friend, a keytech alpha 20. The act of making new useful things locally, give me joy.

projects.name: Single-Cycle MIPS Processor (ACA-MIPS)
projects.description: Design and implementation of a single-cycle MIPS processor in Verilog. Every instruction executes in one clock cycle, with the Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, and Write-Back stages in a single datapath.

projects.name: Custom FPGA Architecture
projects.description: A simple custom FPGA in Verilog, with CLBs, LUT4s, and a routing matrix. Logic was manually synthesized into a 38-bit SRAM bitstream to verify combinational and sequential circuits.

projects.name: Hardware-Accelerated Edge Detection on Zynq SoC
projects.description: Real-time image processing on a Xilinx Zynq-7000 SoC with hardware/software co-design. The Sobel edge detector runs in programmable logic, and a bare-metal C application on the ARM processor manages the camera interface and data flow.

projects.name: PS–PL Image Processing on Zynq SoC
projects.description: Reads an image from an SD card on the processing system, filters it in programmable logic, saves the result back to the SD card, and shows the processed image on an HDMI monitor.

projects.name: PS–PL Accelerated Waveform Generator
projects.description: Hardware/software co-design with a custom programmable-logic IP that accelerates waveform generation. Controlled by a bare-metal application through an interrupt-driven BRAM interface, with AXI transactions debugged using the Vivado ILA.

projects.name: Embedded Security System on Orange Pi
projects.description: A complete embedded security system on Linux: a multi-threaded Python service with OpenCV for real-time face detection, logging new faces to MySQL, and a web control panel for live video, CPU and memory monitoring, and remote configuration through a REST API.

projects.name: UVM Verification of an RTC Clock-Generation Circuit
projects.description: A UVM-based testbench that verifies a submodule of an RTC clock-generation circuit, built to learn the UVM methodology.

projects.name: Parallel Matrix Multiplication on GPU
projects.description: Matrix multiplication in C with the CUDA library, optimized for speed on parallel hardware.
